issues.legal_issue: A claimant seeking possession on the ground of a recent encroachment must prove the alleged encroachment in light of the material evidence concerning the disputed structures.
material_facts: The claimant alleged that the opposing party had recently raised a mud wall and extended a tiled roof onto the land.
The claimant’s vendor acknowledged that the tiled roof and adjoining mud walls had existed for about 28 years and had been affected by salt.
The opposing party testified that the wall and roof had existed for about 28 years, and the court-appointed Amin’s report described them as 25–30 years old.
The lower appellate court found the structures to be recent without considering the opposing party’s testimony and the Amin’s report.
issues.conclusion: The alleged recent encroachment was not proved; the evidence established that the wall and tiled roof were longstanding structures, and the claimant was not entitled to possession on the pleaded encroachment theory.
issues.legal_principle: A claimant seeking recovery of possession on the pleaded basis of trespass and encroachment must prove that case. The court must assess the material evidence on the alleged encroachment; the judgment relies on no statutory provision or earlier case for this conclusion.

rule.if: possession_recovery_proceeding and claim_alleges_recent_encroachment and (vendor_admitted_longstanding_structure or opposing_party_testified_to_longstanding_structure or inspection_report_indicated_old_structure)

predicates.possession_recovery_proceeding: The claimant brought a proceeding seeking possession of land said to have been encroached upon.
predicates.claim_alleges_recent_encroachment: The claimant alleged that the opposing party recently placed or extended a structure onto the claimant’s land.
predicates.vendor_admitted_longstanding_structure: The claimant’s vendor testified that the disputed structure had existed at the site for a long time.
predicates.opposing_party_testified_to_longstanding: The opposing party testified that the disputed structure had existed at the site for a long time.
predicates.inspection_report_indicated_old_structur: A court-appointed inspection report described the disputed structure as old.

issues.definition: When a claimant seeks possession for an alleged recent encroachment and the vendor, opposing party, or inspection report indicates that the structure was longstanding, the claimant is not entitled to possession on that encroachment theory.

issues.legal_issue: A claimant cannot establish entitlement to disputed land through a partition allotment that was not pleaded and where the vendor’s allocation and possession of the land were not averred.
material_facts: The claimant argued that the disputed land had been allotted to the claimant’s vendor under a partition arrangement and that the allotment was reflected in a map and the sale deed.
The plaint did not plead that the disputed property had been partitioned by metes and bounds, allotted to the vendor, or possessed by the vendor from the partition until the sale.
The High Court found that the partition deed did not effect a partition by metes and bounds.
issues.conclusion: The partition-based contention could not be sustained, and the claimant failed to prove the case pleaded in the plaint.
issues.legal_principle: The claimant’s entitlement must be established on the case pleaded; an unpleaded assertion that the disputed land was allotted to the vendor cannot sustain the claim when the allotment and the vendor’s possession were not averred. The judgment relies on no statutory provision or earlier case for this conclusion.

rule.if: possession_recovery_proceeding and claimant_relies_on_partition_allotment and partition_allotment_not_pleaded and vendor_possession_not_pleaded

predicates.possession_recovery_proceeding: The claimant brought a proceeding seeking possession of disputed land.
predicates.claimant_relies_on_partition_allotment: The claimant relied on an asserted division of jointly held property to show that the vendor was entitled to the disputed land.
predicates.partition_allotment_not_pleaded: The claimant did not plead that the disputed land was allotted to the vendor in a partition.
predicates.vendor_possession_not_pleaded: The claimant did not plead that the vendor possessed the disputed land from the partition until the sale.

issues.definition: When a claimant seeking possession relies on a partition allotment but did not plead the allotment or the vendor’s possession, the claimant cannot establish entitlement through that partition-based argument.
